name: Bram Holloway
silhouette: Old, immense, always seated on a bollard or gunwale, stitched-sailcloth coat, unlit pipe.
speech_rhythm: Slow, plural ('we hold', 'we remember'), one proverb per meeting, never threat or plea.
public_motivation: Keep the holdings; be left alone.
private_motivation: Recover the Hullfolk's name; have the theft of the river said aloud.
fear: That the young forget, or that they burn something.
contradiction: A man of peace whose people could sabotage the canal, and who decides yearly not to.
secret: Knows where the Cut's outfall is; has never gone in.
